facts.big: It was raining when I left
facts.label: Tempo no passado
facts.sub: Use was/were + -ing para o tempo e para a ação em andamento, e when + passado simples para o momento: It was raining when I left.

facts.label: Tempo passado
facts.sub: Para falar do tempo no passado, use It was + -ing: It was raining; It was snowing. Para vento, diga The wind was blowing. Use was com it e the wind.

facts.label: Quando
facts.sub: Use when + passado simples para o momento: when I left, when the bus came, when the storm started. A frase fica: It was raining when I left.

paragraphs: It is Monday afternoon on a wide street in Phoenix. The city is usually hot and dry. Today there are puddles on the street. Leo walks in with wet shoes. His friend Zara looks at him in surprise. She wants to know what happened.
“Hi, Leo! You’re wet. Was it raining?” says Zara. “Yes, it was raining when I left home.” says Leo. “In Phoenix? Really? It’s always sunny here!” says Zara.
